Trends of festivals and special events in Malaysia /
School of Tourism and Hospitality Management.

Malaysian too has ventured into this new area of tourism. Various festivals as special events have been planned and offered as an attraction to the tourists. As te potentials and benefits of the event tourism are realized and recognized by the federal and the state governments, private sectors, and also community, that is a significant growth of events in terms of numbers, size and attendance, diversity and professionalism. The purpose of this report is to examine the growth and the development of event tourism in Malaysia, and also to understand future trends. Ten years data of events (1990-2000) were collected and documented. Several important findings were produced from the 10- year inventory of events.

A simulated parametric study of the vivaldi antenna /

A broadband antenna design that has received some attention is the Vivaldi antenna element presented by Gibson [2] i 1979. The basic radiation mechanism for this antenna is a tapered transition between the guided to unguided regions. The Vivaldi antenna is a member of the class of aperiodic, continuously scaled, gradually curved, slow leaky end-fire travelling wave antennas. At different frequencies, different parts of the antenna radiate whie the size of the radiating part is constant in wavelength. The Vivaldi antenna has theoretically unlimited operating frequency range with constant beamwidth over this range.

Faculty of Applied and Creative Arts.

A wireless LAN and Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) interconnected system (internetworking) is proposed and analysed. Wireless LAN and ATM have been standardised by the JEEE802.11 and the ITU-T committees, respectively. Wireless LAN reduces the problems involved in cabling within and across small and medium geographical areas of coverage. ATM is used as the common data transport technology for Broadband ISDN that is intended to support various services such as video, audio, image and data. It is a challenging issue to integrate wireless networks into the B-ISBN or construct a wirreless Internet that allows each mobile individual to transmit multimedia data over broadband networks. The interconnected system enables the mobility functionality to be extended to the ATM network.
